model.name: SprintPinResolver.sprintSlugOf
model.description: sprintSlugOf(unit): the CANONICAL sprint slug from the sourceFile/compoundSource PATH (the real on-disk dir, e.g. sprint-20-traceability-first) via /sprints/(sprint-[^/]+)/ - NEVER slugify(model.name). Slugifying the free-text name mints a phantom slug (sprint-20-radical-forward-planning-...) with no dir (the S20 drift). Companion to sprintNumOf - identity from PATH not name. INV-C1-8 extended: no module derives a sprint NUMBER or SLUG from the name; grep-lint BITE catches slugify(name) too. R-C1 DRY addendum +1.
